item.text:
Subject: Request to Combine Deliveries

Dear [Supplier Name],

I hope you’re well. We have two current orders, [Order #1] and [Order #2], and would like to ask whether they could be combined into a single delivery. Please let us know if this is possible and whether there are any logistical requirements or changes to the delivery schedule. We understand this may not affect the total cost.

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]
